title: Release v5.20.1
excerpt: Release v5.20.1 Special surprise including the new model Beam from Reflection AI 🥳 Beam is a token-efficient, frontier-scale model focused on coding and agentic use cases. It is built for teams that want to run a powerful model on their own hardware, infrastructure, or cloud, and customize it to their specific needs. Links: Documentation Fix small bug in auto mappings ( #49664 ) by @yonigozlan in #49664 Some real patch fixes We broke loading models on older torch versions 😢 should be fixed now. But here is the full list of fixes Fix HunYuan-VL image assignment during batched generation ( #49557 ) by @Arnav66692 Fix DeepGEMM Mega MoE under expert parallelism( #49428 ) by @IlyasMoutawwakil Fix from_pretrained on torch 2.7: require torch>=2.8 for distributed checkpointing ( #49652 ) by @naveecode Make DtensorShardOperation work on torch 2.6 and 2.7 ( #49657 ) by @hazelxue Full Changelog : v5.20.0...v5.20.1
